title: Total Current Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the total current I(t) must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Joule Heat Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The total Joule heat W must be accurately calculated and expressed.

title: Use of Ohm's Law
description: Important Criteria: The application of Ohm's law to relate current density and electric field must be correctly shown.

title: Charge Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The use of charge conservation in deriving the differential equation must be clearly stated.

title: Energy Equivalence
description: Important Criteria: The relationship between Joule heat and decrease in electrostatic energy must be correctly established.

title: Correct Units
description: Optional Criteria: All expressions should include correct units for current and energy.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common sign mistakes in the equations, particularly in the exponential decay term.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all factors, such as constants and coefficients, are included in the final expressions.
